description: Backup & Restore settings tab in the qontinui runner Settings panel. Provides comprehensive data export and import for all 13 user data categories: Flows, Flow Executions, Checkpoints, Learning Outcomes, Learning Patterns, Settings, Prompts, Unified Workflows, Verification Tests, Task Hooks, Scheduled Tasks, Saved API Requests, and Configurations. The page has four always-visible sections: (1) 'Your Data' — live per-category counts fetched via get_export_summary on mount, with a Refresh button; (2) 'Export All Data' — exports to a timestamped JSON file (qontinui-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json) via export_all_data IPC, with an optional per-category selector; (3) 'Import Data' — three-state flow (select file → preview with compatibility check → result), using get_import_preview then import_all_data IPC, with conflict resolution (skip/overwrite) and per-category toggles; (4) Info panel listing what's included and noting that API keys stored in the system keychain are excluded for security. After a successful import the data summary is automatically refreshed.

groups.description: The backup format (version 2.0.0) is a single JSON object with a manifest and 13 category arrays. The manifest contains version (string starting with '2.'), created_at (ISO8601 timestamp), and app_version. The 13 categories cover all persistent user data in the runner database. API keys are explicitly excluded. A version '1.x' backup is accepted for import (backward compatible). Anything else is rejected as incompatible.
groups.name: Backup Data Model — Coverage and Correctness
